meta.title: Jumper · Learn hardware on a 3D breadboard
meta.description: Connect real boards on a 3D breadboard. Jumper guides you like a game.

pitch.title: The fun way to learn hardware engineering.
pitch.body: Wire real boards on a 3D breadboard. Volt tells you what to connect, where, and why.

volt: Hi, I am Volt! I help you wire your first board.

board.label: Perch, wired on the 3D breadboard. Select the board to make an account.

features.title: free. fun. real hardware.
features.body: Each level is short, like a game. You get XP for each correct wire and you move up the level path. At the end, you have a real device, and you did not buy one part.

features.title: based on real kits
features.body: The boards, parts and pins come from real kits. What you wire in Jumper, you can wire on your desk.

features.title: stay motivated
features.body: Get XP for each task and for each level that you pass. Volt is happy with each wire you make.

features.title: learn the why
features.body: Each pop-up tells you what to connect, where, and why. When a wire is wrong, Jumper tells you what that wire does and how to repair it.

examples.why: WS tells the mic when to change between left and right sound.
examples.mistake: This wire connects 3.3 V to ground. Move it to the + rail.

end.title: Make your first light turn on. Right now.
end.body: Make a free account and wire your first LED with Volt. You do not need parts.
